root_cause: The drawer.ts file has two issues causing TypeScript build failure: (1) missing import for the Data module used in _hideChildComponents, and (2) arrow functions in _initSwipe returning Promise<void> from hide() where SwipeConfig expects () => void, creating a type mismatch that the build system reports as a syntax error.
repair_strategy: Add the missing Data import from './dom/data.js' and wrap each this.hide() call in a block statement () => { this.hide() } so the callback returns void, matching SwipeConfig callback signatures.

expected_accessibility_effect: Fixes the TypeScript build error so that subsequent accessibility fixes (e.g., focus management in drawer) can be compiled and verified.
functional_risks: Swipe dismiss callbacks will call hide() but not await the returned promise; this matches the Swipe.execute behavior which does not await callbacks.
Adding the Data import has no runtime side effects; it only makes the existing _hideChildComponents code type-check correctly.
verification_requirements: TypeScript compilation passes with no syntax or type errors in drawer.ts.
Drawer swipe-to-dismiss functionality still works (manual test).
